text:
Done as asked: template v6 (913896f, templates/agent@0553834d7c17), the rheometer request specified again (90901cf), echo/0005 and rheo-fixture/0004 (e648c97), nine failure lines (1bf2b54). Read off runs on the tree with all four: python contracts/validate.py printed VERDICT PASS with failed=0 over 380 cards and 9 bundles, the one pending being your ask; --bundle on each new bundle printed VERDICT PASS, B16 among the checks; meta_agent/tests ran 183 tests, OK; contracts/tests OK. I read the faults again myself in collection collect-3 of run 20261116-2 (sessions 9f586b12 and c1a7c39a) before changing anything. No session has worked in a bundle of v6, so none of this is shown fixed.

Each fault. (a) CLAUDE.md and run-skill name --record for the runner of skills and say the runner of tools writes no file and how its output is kept. (b) The statuses are in run-skill by number, in code, and in CLAUDE.md in words only: B6 lets a bundle's CLAUDE.md carry no number its snapshot does not, and my first text failed it. A test runs both runners and reads the statuses off them. (c) CLAUDE.md and run-skill say a replay item made by hand is compared by src/replay.py and not by eye. (d) CLAUDE.md names README.md and TEMPLATE.json and says neither binds. (e) The builder writes CAPABILITIES.json with the name of the document and not its path, a list held of the held skills with the tools they would call, and not_here on a claim whose words name such a tool; CLAUDE.md says what the mark means. The mark is a match of tool names as whole words in the claim's text, so it can miss a claim that speaks of a tool without naming it. (f) The Designer could not specify an existing request again, so I gave it the mode: --respecify runs S4 from the latest revision of the intake and writes the next revision of each card that differs, and --rebuild now reads the latest intake. v2_intake.json corrects the status contract from the fixture's documentation: fault declared, temperature in K and gap in m, time and run_id declared with no type because the documentation states none. (g) No table in the bundle. CLAUDE.md says the builder derives a grade and a bundle does not: deriving it is a calculation, a calculation in a bundle is a library skill, the library has none, and a table without the skill would be read by hand. The reason is in TEMPLATE.json's note, which the bundle carries; diff_from_template.txt is generated and holds no sentence of mine. (h) CLAUDE.md names your six keys. Beyond your list, one thing the echo session met: CLAUDE.md now says the three commands of the start task are checks and not tool calls.

What I need from you, or leave with you. (1) The session skill specify-and-build names --rebuild only; a request whose intake is revised now needs --respecify first, and the skill is yours. (2) B6 and units: the Tools section now prints the unit a contract names, and six units of contracts/units.json (1, m^2, m^3, m/s^2, kg/m^3, g/cm^3) would be read by B6 as numbers that are not in the snapshot. Neither build has one (K and m only). Whether B6 should pass a unit, or the builder should write units another way, is yours to say; I worked around nothing. (3) A line of meta_agent/failures.jsonl had no form either, the file having been empty; I used at, kind, task, detail, the shape plan and tasks/006 take from the earlier repository, with kind deviation. Say if you want another.

For the card and docs/ideas, what the person said to this session after my first note, verbatim. Before any session was opened the person wrote "세 세션 모두 멈췄어, collect 해줘" [all three sessions have stopped, collect]; I collected (collect-1: no session, nothing changed, no transcript in the application for the run's folders), said so, and the person answered by the button "Not opened yet" (label mine). Then: "너가 열 수 없어?" [can't you open them?]. I had said I could on the person's word and what it costs the test; I read the question as that word and opened the three, and the person has not said otherwise. So all three sessions of this run were opened by this seat through the application: each was also given the application's instructions for a session started by another and a notes folder outside its own. The rheometer session listed that notes folder in its second call, a read outside its folder that its bundle does not ask for; no session wrote outside its folder. The levels I asked for were sonnet-5-5 at medium, opus-5-5 at high and fable-5-2 at xhigh; the collection shows each session's model and not its effort, so the effort is what I asked for and is not read off a record.

Limits of what I read. The clone session was still working at collect-3 (43 calls, two commits in the clone) and I have read nothing of it. The collection's line for a session says it wrote no file while the bundle's item lists the files its shell commands added; the collection says so under what it cannot see, but the session line alone misleads. No case is written: each cause here is a sentence of the template and what corrected it is not yet shown by a run. I do not remove the run or its sessions.
